title: 5-Day Athens & Saronic Islands Escorted Tour
metaDescription: Combine Athens and Delphi with a Saronic Islands cruise to Hydra, Poros and Aegina on a 5-day Greece journey blending history, islands and coastal scenery.

summary:
The 5-Day Greece Tour is a compact mainland journey for travelers who want to explore Greece beyond Athens without adding an island stay. After visiting the Acropolis, the route continues through Mycenae and Epidaurus to ancient Olympia, then crosses central Greece for Delphi and the rock-top monasteries of Meteora. Nafplio adds a smaller historic town to a route otherwise shaped by major archaeological sites and classical history.
Available throughout the year, the five-day program includes selected 4-star hotels with breakfast, English-speaking local guides, transfers, entrance fees and the scheduled sightseeing detailed in the itinerary.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Athens
itinerary.text:
Arrival at Athens International Airport. Meet and transfer to your hotel in Athens.
Check-in after 14:00. Rest of the day at leisure. Overnight in Athens.

itinerary.title: Athens City Tour
itinerary.text:
Breakfast at the hotel.
Enjoy a half-day guided tour of Athens, including the Acropolis of Athens, Acropolis Museum, and Parthenon. Continue past the Parliament, Tomb of the Unknown Soldier, Presidential Palace, Panathenaic Stadium, Temple of Olympian Zeus, and Arch of Hadrian. Afternoon at leisure. Overnight in Athens.

itinerary.title: Cruise to Hydra, Poros and Aegina
itinerary.text: Breakfast at the hotel. Transfer to the port for a full-day Saronic Islands cruise visiting Hydra, Poros, and Aegina. Enjoy free time to explore the islands, relax by the waterfront, and admire the beautiful scenery. Lunch will be served on board. During the return cruise to Athens, enjoy a traditional Greek folk show with music and dancing. Overnight in Athens.

itinerary.title: Day Trip to Delphi from Athens
itinerary.text: Breakfast at the hotel. Depart for a full-day tour to Delphi, home of the famous oracle of Ancient Greece. Visit the archaeological site including the Temple of Apollo at Delphi, Treasury of the Athenians, Ancient Theatre, Stadium, and the Delphi Archaeological Museum. See the famous bronze Charioteer statue and other ancient masterpieces. After lunch in Delphi village, return to Athens in the evening. Overnight in Athens.

itinerary.title: Departure from Istanbul
itinerary.text:
After breakfast, check out from the hotel before 12:00 pm.
Transfer to Istanbul Airport according to your flight departure time.

faqs.q: What destinations are included in the 5-Day Athens, Hydra & Poros Tour?
faqs.a: The 5-Day Athens, Hydra & Poros Tour covers Athens, Hydra, Poros, and Delphi. You will explore Athens' ancient landmarks, visit the charming islands of Hydra and Poros in the Saronic Gulf, and discover the world-famous archaeological site of Delphi, once considered the center of the ancient Greek world. The tour runs for 4 nights and 5 days.

faqs.q: How much does the 5-Day Athens, Hydra & Poros Tour cost?
faqs.a: The tour starts from €995 per person for the 2026 season. The price includes accommodation, ferry transportation as outlined in the itinerary, guided sightseeing tours, entrance fees according to the itinerary, selected meals, and all hotel and port transfers. Final pricing may vary depending on travel dates and hotel availability.

faqs.q: Are ferry tickets included in this itinerary?
faqs.a: Yes, ferry transportation to Hydra and Poros is included according to the itinerary. These scenic journeys allow you to experience the beauty of the Saronic Gulf while visiting two of Greece's most charming islands.

faqs.q: What kind of accommodation does the tour provide?
faqs.a: The package includes 4 nights at carefully selected 4-star hotels with daily breakfast. Hotels are chosen for their comfort, service quality, and convenient locations near major attractions and transportation points.

faqs.q: Does the 5-day Athens, Hydra & Poros Tour include a guide?
faqs.a: Yes, professional English-speaking guides are included during the scheduled sightseeing tours. Your guides provide historical insights, cultural information, and local expertise throughout the journey.

faqs.q: Is this tour suitable for first-time visitors to Greece?
faqs.a: Yes, this tour is ideal for first-time visitors looking for a combination of ancient history, island charm, and cultural experiences. It offers an excellent introduction to both mainland Greece and the beautiful Saronic Islands.

faqs.q: How fit do I need to be for the tour?
faqs.a: The physical difficulty is easy to moderate. Travelers should be comfortable walking through archaeological sites, island villages, ferry ports, and historic districts. Delphi includes some walking on uneven terrain, but most travelers in average health can comfortably participate.

faqs.q: What are the highlights of Hydra, Poros, and Delphi?
faqs.a: Hydra is famous for its car-free streets, elegant mansions, picturesque harbor, and artistic atmosphere. Poros is known for its waterfront cafés, pine-covered hills, and relaxed island charm. Delphi features the Sanctuary of Apollo, the ancient theater, stadium, and one of Greece's most important archaeological museums.

faqs.q: What is the cancellation policy for the Athens, Hydra & Poros Tour?
faqs.a: You can cancel free of charge up to 30 days before the tour departure date. Cancellations made within 30 days may be subject to fees according to the booking terms and cancellation policy. Travel insurance is recommended for additional flexibility and protection.

faqs.q: Is the 5-Day Athens, Hydra & Poros Tour available all year and can it be customized?
faqs.a: Yes, the tour operates throughout the year, subject to ferry schedules. You can add extra nights in Athens or the islands, upgrade hotel categories, include additional excursions, or modify the itinerary according to your preferences. Contact Magnificent Travel for a personalized itinerary and quotation.
